format: Traditional free-standing Sonic Drive-In, leased scenario (excluding free-standing real estate costs)

invest.quote: The total investment necessary to begin operation of a Traditional Sonic Drive-In franchise ranges from $1,485,200 to 2,522,900. This includes $15,250 to $17,650 that must be paid to the franchisor or affiliate.

fee.quote: Traditional Drive-In location or Non-Drive-In Location $15,000
fee.note: $12,500 (or $5,000 for an existing franchisee in good standing) at the location of a SONIC Restaurant another franchisee closed within the last year; $11,250 for Non-Traditional Locations and C-Stores; $0 for relocation. Training for first 3 people included; $5,000 per person for the 4th or subsequent trainee; $250 per General Manager Leadership Class attendee. Development fee $10,000 per Restaurant, credited against the franchise fee. In fiscal 2025 initial franchise fees paid ranged from $1,250 to $45,000.

royalty.quote: Royalty fee(2) 5% of Gross Sales(2) Payable monthly on the 10th day of the next month

adFund.quote: Advertising cooperative fee/SMF contribution(4) 1.625% (Minimum) of Gross Sales for Non-Traditional Locations and Non-Drive-In Locations that are C-Stores Otherwise, 3.25% (Minimum) of Gross Sales
adFund.note: Traditional Drive-Ins: 3.25% minimum, up to 5% of Gross Sales (cooperative may vote more). Allocation by market: Core 0.5% cooperative + 2.75% to 4.5% SMF; Developing 0.5% + 4.5%; New none + 5%. Separate Brand fee/SBF contribution of 0.90% of Gross Sales. Standard incentive: royalty 1% year 1, 1.5% year 2, 2% year 3, 2.5% year 4, 5% from year 5 for new Traditional Restaurants signed by March 31, 2027.

otherRecurring.name: Brand fee/SBF contribution
otherRecurring.amount: 0.90% of Gross Sales, payable monthly to the Sonic Brand Fund

otherRecurring.name: Inspire Payment Services
otherRecurring.amount: Currently about $365 to $565 per month, depending on the products and services covered

transferFee.amount: $1,000 for each non-control transfer, immediate family transfer, or transfer to a wholly-owned entity, and $3,000 for other transfers

headline.label: Average AUV (annual Gross Sales), franchised Traditional Restaurants open all of 2025

item19.note: Gross Sales only; does not reflect costs of sales or operating expenses. Excludes 29 franchised restaurants opened in 2025, 23 closed for extended periods, 1 Multi-Brand, 10 Non-Traditional, 3 transferred from company in December 2025, 56 that closed in 2025, and all company-owned restaurants. 1,338 / 44% above average.

special: Total of royalty 5% + SMF/cooperative 3.25% minimum + Brand fee 0.90% of Gross Sales for a Traditional Drive-In. Investment excludes land/building acquisition for free-standing sites (leased scenario; real property 'Variable'). New-unit incentive royalty ramps from 1% to 5% over 5 years, with an additional 0.5% of Gross Sales collected for the cooperative during those years.
